title: Glowing rose
svg:
<svg viewBox='0 0 100 100' xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'>
  <defs>
    <radialGradient id='glow' cx='50%' cy='50%' r='50%'>
      <stop offset='0%' stop-color='#ff88cc' stop-opacity='0.8'/>
      <stop offset='70%' stop-color='#ff4488' stop-opacity='0.3'/>
      <stop offset='100%' stop-color='#ff2266' stop-opacity='0'/>
    </radialGradient>
    <radialGradient id='petalGlow' cx='50%' cy='50%' r='50%'>
      <stop offset='0%' stop-color='#ffaadd'/>
      <stop offset='60%' stop-color='#ff5588'/>
      <stop offset='100%' stop-color='#cc2266'/>
    </radialGradient>
    <radialGradient id='petalInner' cx='50%' cy='50%' r='50%'>
      <stop offset='0%' stop-color='#ffccdd'/>
      <stop offset='60%' stop-color='#ff3377'/>
      <stop offset='100%' stop-color='#aa1155'/>
    </radialGradient>
  </defs>

  <!-- Glow aura -->
  <circle cx='50' cy='42' r='32' fill='url(#glow)'/>

  <!-- Stem -->
  <path d='M50 52 Q48 68 50 82 Q51 88 49 94' stroke='#33cc66' stroke-width='4' fill='none' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <!-- Stem lighter edge -->
  <path d='M50 52 Q48 68 50 82 Q51 88 49 94' stroke='#66ff99' stroke-width='1.5' fill='none' stroke-linecap='round' opacity='0.6'/>

  <!-- Leaves -->
  <path d='M49 70 Q38 64 33 70 Q36 76 49 75 Z' fill='#33cc66'/>
  <path d='M49 70 Q38 64 33 70 Q36 76 49 75 Z' fill='#88ffbb' opacity='0.4' transform='translate(-1,-1) scale(0.9) translate(5,7)'/>
  <path d='M51 60 Q62 54 67 60 Q64 66 51 65 Z' fill='#33cc66'/>
  <path d='M51 60 Q62 54 67 60 Q64 66 51 65 Z' fill='#88ffbb' opacity='0.4' transform='translate(1,-1) scale(0.9) translate(-5,7)'/>

  <!-- Outer petals -->
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='32' rx='14' ry='16' fill='url(#petalGlow)' transform='rotate(0 50 42)'/>
  <ellipse cx='38' cy='40' rx='14' ry='16' fill='url(#petalGlow)' transform='rotate(-60 38 40)'/>
  <ellipse cx='62' cy='40' rx='14' ry='16' fill='url(#petalGlow)' transform='rotate(60 62 40)'/>
  <ellipse cx='42' cy='50' rx='13' ry='15' fill='url(#petalGlow)' transform='rotate(-120 42 50)'/>
  <ellipse cx='58' cy='50' rx='13' ry='15' fill='url(#petalGlow)' transform='rotate(120 58 50)'/>

  <!-- Middle petals -->
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='36' rx='10' ry='12' fill='url(#petalInner)' transform='rotate(15 50 36)'/>
  <ellipse cx='41' cy='43' rx='10' ry='12' fill='url(#petalInner)' transform='rotate(-50 41 43)'/>
  <ellipse cx='59' cy='43' rx='10' ry='12' fill='url(#petalInner)' transform='rotate(50 59 43)'/>
  <ellipse cx='45' cy='50' rx='9' ry='11' fill='url(#petalInner)' transform='rotate(-110 45 50)'/>
  <ellipse cx='55' cy='50' rx='9' ry='11' fill='url(#petalInner)' transform='rotate(110 55 50)'/>

  <!-- Inner swirl petals -->
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='40' rx='6' ry='8' fill='#ff2266' transform='rotate(20 50 40)'/>
  <ellipse cx='46' cy='45' rx='6' ry='7' fill='#ff2266' transform='rotate(-40 46 45)'/>
  <ellipse cx='54' cy='45' rx='6' ry='7' fill='#ff2266' transform='rotate(40 54 45)'/>

  <!-- Center spiral -->
  <circle cx='50' cy='44' r='3.5' fill='#ff99cc'/>
  <path d='M50 41 Q53 44 50 47 Q47 44 50 41' fill='none' stroke='#ffddee' stroke-width='1.2'/>
  <circle cx='50' cy='44' r='1.2' fill='#ffffff' opacity='0.9'/>

  <!-- Sparkles -->
  <circle cx='30' cy='28' r='1.5' fill='#ffddee' opacity='0.8'/>
  <circle cx='72' cy='30' r='1.2' fill='#ffddee' opacity='0.7'/>
  <circle cx='26' cy='48' r='1' fill='#ffddee' opacity='0.6'/>
  <circle cx='74' cy='50' r='1.3' fill='#ffddee' opacity='0.7'/>
  <circle cx='50' cy='20' r='1.4' fill='#ffddee' opacity='0.6'/>
  <circle cx='35' cy='22' r='0.9' fill='#ffccdd' opacity='0.5'/>
  <circle cx='65' cy='22' r='0.9' fill='#ffccdd' opacity='0.5'/>
</svg>
